title: 3 NEW Sanguine Urns in Scorned Wilderness | +30 HP – RuneScape Dragonwilds
author: RuneScape Universe
description:
All 3 Sanguine Urn locations in the Scorned Wilderness in RuneScape: Dragonwilds!

In this quick guide, I’ll show you exactly where to find all three hidden Sanguine Urns during the Scorned Wilderness raid, how to unlock the gates protecting them, and the routes you need to take to reach each one.

Thanks for watching! 🎮
Subscribe for more RuneScape Dragonwilds and OSRS adventures.

transcript.text: Hey guys, in this quick tutorial I'll show you where to find all three hidden sanguine urns and how to unlock them in
the new Scorned Wilderness region in RuneScape Dragon Wilds. The first sanguine urn is located in Fragments of
Gornviel, which you can see here on the map. Head up these stairs where you'll first need to deal with another black
dragon along with a Garou'than, berserker, and goblin bodyguards. Clear all the enemies here first and then we
can work on unlocking the urn. Stand on the Earth Anima portal until you're fully charged, then follow my path to
the pylon. Transfer the Earth Anima energy into it and this will unlock the gates leading to the sanguine urn.
You can ignore the monster near the pylon. Just charge it with the Earth Anima and keep moving. Once it's
activated, follow my path to the room where the gates have now opened.
And here it is, your first sanguine urn. Grab it to permanently increase your health and now let's move on to the
second one. The second sanguine urn is also located within Fragments of Gornviel, but this one will require a
little bit of parkour to reach during your raid run. Once you reach the lift inside the dungeon castle, slow down and
pay attention. It's easy to rush past this part and miss the urn. First, we need to unlock the gates leading to it.
You can see the exact location of the lever here on the map. Pull this lever in the room. You'll notice the gates
directly in front of you don't open. That's because this lever actually unlocks the gates where the sanguine urn
is hidden. From here, just follow my exact path and you'll reach it in no time. Be careful with the jumps along
the way though because it's very easy to miss one and fall straight into the pit.
And as you can see, the second sanguine urn is right down here. If you didn't pull that lever earlier, these gates
would still be closed. Grab the urn, then carefully make your way back to the main path. Take your time with the jumps
because it's very easy to miss one and fall into the pit. Right, that's two down. Now it's time for the final
Sanguine urn. And now for the third and final Sanguine urn. This one is found much further into the raid, so before
leaving this area, make sure you don't miss it. Use the valves to move the platforms out from the walls, then use
your wind step ability to make your way across toward the urn hidden in side the wall. Just follow my exact path, take
your time with the jumps, and grab the final Sanguine urn for another permanent health increase.
And that's it. All three Sanguine urns collected in the Scorned Wilderness, giving you a nice permanent boost to
your maximum health. Hopefully this quick guide helped you find them without missing any during your raid run. If it
helped, leave a like. Subscribe for more RuneScape Dragon Wilds guides, and I'll see you in the next one.
